_comment: Removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability: the card has no intimidate text. The generator hallucinated it from Blade Break equipment (27 cards corpus-wide). The remaining STATIC used MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE with an invented COUNT expression -- and a STATIC ability maps to no event, so it never ran at all. Its {d} is an EXPRESSION, so it is declared as DEFENSE_EQUALS and evaluated where the defending card's {d} is consumed.
